        <article class="hs-card"><div class="hs-step">02</div><div class="hs-kicker">Step</div><div class="hs-title">Spatiotemporal harmonisation</div><div class="hs-text">Atmospheric correction, cloud masking, and multi-year time series alignment at territorial scale.</div></article>
        <article class="hs-card"><div class="hs-step">03</div><div class="hs-kicker">Step</div><div class="hs-title">Deep learning and foundation models</div><div class="hs-text">Semantic segmentation, geospatial foundation models, and applied language models for complex representations.</div></article>
        <article class="hs-card"><div class="hs-step">04</div><div class="hs-kicker">Step</div><div class="hs-title">Auditing and official validation</div><div class="hs-text">Systematic benchmarking against INPE field references (DETER and PRODES), ZARC zoning, MapBiomas, and uncertainty metrics.</div></article>
        <article class="hs-card"><div class="hs-step">05</div><div class="hs-kicker">Step</div><div class="hs-title">Actionable intelligence</div><div class="hs-text">Generation of risk indicators, territorial monitoring tools, and open-source code supporting decision-makers.</div></article>
